description_en: Query the list of user message records based on the query conditions, including the start time and the number of entries to return
description_zh: 查询用户的留言消息列表，基于查询条件开始时间，查询条数返回结果
name: ListUserMessage

parameters.help_en: After a specific point in time
parameters.name: before_time

fields.help_en: Encoding type. There are multiple ways to obtain the user identifier for Maojing, and each method corresponds to a different encoding type: - PACKAGENAME: APK package name, used for Android application client links - SKILLID: Skill ID, used for cloud-based links
fields.help_zh: 编码类型，获取猫精的用户标识的途径有多种，不同途径对应不同的编码类型 - PACKAGENAME：apk包名，Android应用客户链路的编码类型 - SKILLID：技能ID，云端链路的编码类型
fields.name: encode_type

fields.help_en: Value corresponding to the encoding type. When the encoding type is SKILLID, this value is the application's Skill ID. When the encoding type is PACKAGENAME, this value is the packageName of the corresponding client app.
fields.help_zh: 编码类型对应的值，编码类型是SKILLID时，其值为应用的Skill ID； 编码类型是PACKAGENAME时，其值为对应客户端App的packageName
fields.name: encode_key

fields.help_en: Type of user ID: - OPENID: Default user ID identifier - UNIONID: Organization-level user ID identifier, available only after an organization has been registered on the Maojing skill application Open Platform
fields.help_zh: 用户Id的类型 - OPENID：默认的用户ID标识 - UNIONID: 组织维度的用户ID标识，在猫精技能应用开放平台申请过组织后才会有
fields.name: id_type

fields.help_en: Organization ID. Required when IdType is UNION_ID
fields.name: organization_id
